'''Silver Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] consisting of [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]] marked with [[Silver/Legends|silver]] trim to identify their squad affiliation. The fighters were equipped with enhanced [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] targeting systems.
